[20C|...|
[20C-----



Wizard the Evoker[14CSt:9 Dx:14 Co:13 In:20 Wi:10 Ch:9 Chaotic
Dlvl:1 $:0 HP:11(11) Pw:7(7) AC:9 Xp:1

segments.comment: A Wizard maps the level with wizard-mode ^F, steps off the up stairs, and looks into a wished blessed crystal ball for '{'. detect.c furniture_detect() finds every furniture square already shown, so it prints "Your map already shows all relevant locations." and calls display_nhwindow(WIN_MAP, TRUE) (detect.c:1124-1125). MSGTYPE=hide hides that message and "You peer into...", which leaves the answered "What do you look for?" prompt as a TOPLINE_NON_EMPTY line. wintty.c tty_display_nhwindow()'s NHW_MAP arm promotes it to --More-- and waits; map_redisplay()'s cls() would not. Seed, clock, character, options and keys were chosen for this path.
